title: Verify: Zustand game store, useGame and BootScene state reading unit tests
summary: Unit tests prove a single state owner and subscription cleanup.
description: Test gameStore, useGame and BootScene with phaser mocked.
acceptance_criteria: Given store state, Then BootScene.readState returns the same reference.
Given shutdown, Then unsubscribe is called.
technical_constraints: vi.mock('phaser') with a Scene base class stub holding an events emitter

steps.action: vi.mock('phaser', ...) providing default {Scene: class {events = {once: vi.fn()}}, Scenes:{Events:{SHUTDOWN:'shutdown'}}}. Build a GameState with createInitialState from @game/state/gameState and the world and scene from ../src/runtime/content. Test (1) useGameStore.setState({state}) then new BootScene().readState() toBe(state); (2) after create(), setting a new state calls onStateChange (spy) and readState returns the new reference; (3) capture the once('shutdown') callback, invoke it, then change the store and assert onStateChange is not called; (4) phaserToReact listener receives sceneReady on create().
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootScene.test.ts

steps.action: Test init sets state once and a second init does not overwrite; setState applies the updater to the current state. Reset the store with useGameStore.setState({state:null}) in beforeEach.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/gameStore.test.ts tests/useGame.test.tsx
steps.expected: Store tests and existing useGame tests pass with the unchanged return shape.
